name: Slot Roll to Image Wall
description:
An 18 second vertical reel for a product with a long feature list. A navigation menu rolls past like a slot machine and comes to rest on the one entry you want remembered. The camera pushes into it, a wall of your own images drifts by, and one of those images grows into the closing frame behind your name and your line.

Swap in your own menu entries and icons, your own images and your own voice-over. Made for product launches, app releases and library announcements. 1080 x 1920, reads with sound off.
